title: Payhook — Subscription Events
objective: Billing webhooks upgrade an account to Pro once their signature is verified. Upgrade your account without a correctly signed event.

verifier.condition: A webhook with no signature header at all grants Pro access.

weakness: The webhook handler verifies the signature only when a signature header is present, and a request with the header missing entirely skips verification instead of being rejected.
seededData: An account on the Basic plan with no billing events yet. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Send a correctly signed event first and see what a valid request actually looks like.
A check that runs 'if a signature is given, verify it' is not the same promise as 'a signature is required'.
Send the same event with the signature header removed entirely, not just left blank or wrong.
burpNotes: Send the webhook request with the signature header deleted, not emptied.
